models: analogues in RRG space, price read back
gravity + tidal price forecast, RRG step computed from it

transitions.note: How often a line in one RRG quadrant (around 100 / 100) was in each quadrant h weeks later, pooled over weeks and lines. Rotation is smooth by construction, so staying put and clockwise moves dominate at short horizons; weeks overlap, so the independent periods are the non-overlapping windows. History, not a forecast.

dual.note: Each company against its industry without itself (most specific SIC level with five or more other companies, each counted while liquid; today's companies), grouped by where the company stood against that industry and where the industry stood against the S&P 500; the share in each quadrant h weeks later. History, not a forecast.

note: Next RS-Ratio / RS-Momentum: kernel-weighted mean of the next steps of the 80 most similar past weekly states (position and last step) of any line. The next point is an exact function of next week's close (same formula as the chart), so the close whose point is nearest the forecast is the price read back from it; plus the benchmark's average weekly return up to that week. The analogue metric (the spread of each coordinate) is measured on the weeks before each library rebuild only, so no past week uses later data.
